The '''White Maw''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to the [[Third Galactic War]]. The White Maw were known for their salvage operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==Description==
The White Maw was a large coalition of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups operating mainly on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] around [[3642 BBY]].<ref name="CX" />

==History==
===Establishment===
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], many pirates flocked to Hoth to join the White Maw.<ref name="CX" />

By 3642 BBY, the White Maw were considered by Senator [[Tobas Grell]] to be the largest pirate band in the galaxy.<ref name="The Coalition" />

===Galactic War===
In 3642 BBY, at the start of the [[Galactic War]] between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the White Maw participated in many events involving both factions on Hoth.<ref name="CX" /> Pirate leader [[Grossh]] was killed by a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] attack on the pirates.<ref name="Position of Power" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]] was a prominent pirate&mdash;famous for attacking the [[Rift Alliance]]'s forces&mdash;who was defeated by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] and taken into the Republic's custody.<ref name="The Coalition" />

The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] sent his minion [[Shai Tenna]] with his [[Shai Tenna's crew|crew]] to try to take over the White Maw coalition but Tenna and his men were defeated by a Republic-affiliated [[Voidhound|smuggler]] aboard the crashed ''[[Star of Coruscant]]''. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] was granted the option to take Tenna's position and lead the White Maw but refused.<ref name="Divided Loyalties" />

A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], known as the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], arrived on Hoth to hunt down a [[Blacklist]] target. Their target was the pirate lord [[Reneget Vause]], who the bounty hunter eventually eliminated after taking out several [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of the White Maw.<ref name="Cool Reception" />

Master [[Sav]] led a radical White Maw band called the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]] but was eliminated that year by either Republic or Imperial forces.<ref name="Hailstorm" /> The bands [[Marauders (White Maw)|Marauders]] and [[Scourge (White Maw)|Scourge]] joined forces with the rogue Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] named [[Layek Davos]] to acquire the ''[[Starbreeze]]'', an advanced [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] lost during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] in the [[Great Galactic War]]. Their forces were intercepted and eliminated by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss forces]] and the [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] soon after the shuttle's discovery.<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze" />

Most of the White Maw's leadership was killed in an Imperial attack during a meeting on their headquarters at the [[Coldstone Canyon]].<ref name="Breaking the Maw" />

==Behind the scenes==
The smuggler player character has the option of taking control of a White Maw group or pass leadership to [[Alilia]].<ref name="Divided Loyalties" />
